label.title: Label
label.description: Human-readable label for this config item.

value.title: Value
value.description: Current value of this config item.

field_type.title: Field Type
field_type.description: UI field type used to render this config item, if specified.

description.title: Description
description.description: Free-text description of what this config item controls.

list_options.title: List Options
list_options.description: Allowed choices when this item is a selectable list, if applicable.

field.title: Field
field.description: Name of the other config field this item depends on.

value.title: Value
value.description: Value the referenced field must have for this item to apply.

depends_on.description: Conditional dependency that determines whether this item applies.

config.title: Config
config.description: Full replacement list of the node's config fields.

auto_commit.title: Auto Commit
auto_commit.description: Whether to immediately commit and propagate this change (workflow builder behavior). When false, the edit is left uncommitted in the acting user's dev clone, to be committed explicitly later (scripting page behavior).
